from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import re, math

carrier_ids={'185','184','285','287','353','354','556','557','533','381','396','397','489','490','499','500','503','504','613','614'}
files=[]
for p in sorted(Path('inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
    m=re.search(r'_CHIP_(\\d+)',p.name)
    if m and m.group(1) in carrier_ids:
        files.append((m.group(1),p))
print('carrier files present',len(files), [x[0] for x in files])
all_effect=Counter(); all_so=Counter(); low_effect=Counter(); low_so=Counter(); low_rows=[]
for sid,p in files:
    ws=load_workbook(p,data_only=True,read_only=False).active
    hdr=[c.value for c in ws[2]]
    idx={h:i for i,h in enumerate(hdr)}
    counts=Counter(); so=Counter(); n=0
    for vals in ws.iter_rows(min_row=3,values_only=True):
        # use genotype VAF (col 10)
        v=vals[idx['Variant Allele Freq']]
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and not isinstance(v,bool):
            all_effect[str(vals[idx['Effect (Combined)']])] += 1
            all_so[str(vals[idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']])] += 1
            if v < 0.3:
                n += 1
                eff=str(vals[idx['Effect (Combined)']]); ont=str(vals[idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']])
                low_effect[eff]+=1; low_so[ont]+=1
                low_rows.append((sid, vals[idx['Chr:Pos']], vals[idx['Ref/Alt']], v, vals[idx['Zygosity']], vals[idx['Gene Names']], ont, eff, vals[idx['HGVS c. (Clinically Relevant)']]))
                counts[eff]+=1; so[ont]+=1
    print('\\nSID',sid,'lowVAF rows',n,'effects',dict(counts),'SO',dict(so))
print('\\nALL VAF nonblank effects',all_effect)
print('\\nLOW VAF effects',low_effect)
print('\\nLOW VAF SO',low_so)
print('\\nlow rows',len(low_rows))
for r in low_rows[:40]: print(r)
PY"

import re
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Carrier IDs from the supplied trio-status workbook.
status = pd.read_excel('inputs/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx', header=0, dtype=object)
status['Sample ID'] = status['Sample ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
carrier_ids = set(status.loc[status['BLM Mutation Status'].eq('Carrier'), 'Sample ID'])

records=[]
for path in sorted(Path('inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
    m=re.search(r'_CHIP_(\\d+)', path.name)
    if not m or m.group(1) not in carrier_ids:
        continue
    sid=m.group(1)
    df=pd.read_excel(path, header=1, dtype=object)
    df['sample_id']=sid
    records.append(df)
allv=pd.concat(records,ignore_index=True)
allv['vaf_num']=pd.to_numeric(allv['Variant Allele Freq'], errors='coerce')
# Coding terms represented in these records; retain standard coding SO consequences.
coding_terms={'synonymous_variant','missense_variant','stop_gained','stop_lost','start_lost','frameshift_variant','inframe_insertion','inframe_deletion','protein_altering_variant','coding_sequence_variant'}
q=allv[allv['vaf_num'].lt(0.3) & allv['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].isin(coding_terms)]
print('carrier IDs in metadata:',len(carrier_ids),sorted(carrier_ids,key=lambda x:(not x.isdigit(),int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)))
print('carrier workbooks loaded:',len(records),sorted([d['sample_id'].iloc[0] for d in records],key=lambda x:int(x)))
print('qualifying rows:',len(q))
print('SO counts:',q['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].value_counts().to_dict())
print('synonymous fraction:',q['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].eq('synonymous_variant').sum()/len(q))
# Confirm coding count does not change if reference/no-call rows are removed.
q_called=q[q['Zygosity'].ne('Reference')]
print('called coding rows:',len(q_called),'called SO counts:',q_called['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].value_counts().to_dict())
print('threshold boundary rows:',(allv['vaf_num'].eq(0.3)).sum())

from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from collections import Counter
import re

NS='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
def col_index(ref):
    letters=''.join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
    n=0
    for ch in letters:
        n=n*26+ord(ch.upper())-64
    return n-1

def read_sheet(path):
    with ZipFile(path) as z:
        ss=[]
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
            root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
            for si in root.findall(NS+'si'):
                ss.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(NS+'t')))
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
        rows=[]
        for row in root.findall('.//'+NS+'row'):
            vals={}
            for c in row.findall(NS+'c'):
                v=c.find(NS+'v')
                if v is None: value=None
                else:
                    raw=v.text
                    value=ss[int(raw)] if c.get('t')=='s' else raw
                vals[col_index(c.get('r'))]=value
            if vals:
                rows.append([vals.get(i) for i in range(max(vals)+1)])
        return rows

status_rows=read_sheet('inputs/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx')
headers=status_rows[0]
status=[dict(zip(headers,row+[None]*(len(headers)-len(row)))) for row in status_rows[1:]]
carrier_ids={str(r['Sample ID']).strip() for r in status if r.get('BLM Mutation Status')=='Carrier'}

coding={'synonymous_variant','missense_variant','stop_gained','stop_lost','start_lost','frameshift_variant','inframe_insertion','inframe_deletion','protein_altering_variant','coding_sequence_variant'}
q=[]
loaded=[]
for path in sorted(Path('inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx')):
    m=re.search(r'_CHIP_(\\d+)',path.name)
    if not m or m.group(1) not in carrier_ids: continue
    sid=m.group(1); rows=read_sheet(str(path)); h=rows[1]; ix={x:i for i,x in enumerate(h)}; loaded.append(sid)
    for row in rows[2:]:
        row=row+[None]*(len(h)-len(row))
        v=row[ix['Variant Allele Freq']]
        try: v=float(v) if v not in (None,'') else None
        except (TypeError,ValueError): v=None
        so=row[ix['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']]
        if v is not None and v < .3 and so in coding:
            q.append((sid,so,row[ix['Zygosity']]))
print('carrier IDs:',len(carrier_ids))
print('loaded workbooks:',len(loaded),sorted(loaded,key=int))
print('qualifying records:',len(q))
print('coding SO:',dict(Counter(x[1] for x in q)))
print('synonymous fraction:',format(sum(x[1]=='synonymous_variant' for x in q)/len(q),'.17g'))
print('called coding records:',len([x for x in q if x[2]"'!='"'Reference']))
